view: View along grassy semicircular earth rampart at Hedeby descending toward Haddeby Noor inlet, reeds foreground, open low meadow, subtle shallow archaeological trench with timber traces, no reconstructed Viking village.

eras.title: The edge of a trading town
eras.caption: At Hedeby, roads, buildings and harbour remains survive beneath the ground beside the water. Its earthwork boundary helps trace a trading settlement that connected routes across land and sea.
